Questions

Frequently asked.

Do I need to pay an agent fee?

No. Every price shown on a listing is the full price — there's no separate agent commission added on top.

How do I book a viewing?

Open any listing and use the WhatsApp or contact form button to request a viewing. Our team responds within 24 hours to confirm a time.

Are the listing photos and videos accurate?

Yes — every listing is shot on-site by our team, never stock photography, so what you see is what you'll find at viewing.

What do I need to move in?

Valid ID, proof of income or employment, and the agreed deposit. Our team will walk you through the exact paperwork for your chosen apartment.

Do you have apartments outside Lagos?

Yes — we also manage listings across Ogun State, including Sango Ota, Ago Iwoye, and Abeokuta.

Ready to find your next home?

No agent gatekeeping. No endless calls. Just real apartments at real prices.

About Aveon Housing

Renting in Lagos shouldn't be a guessing game.

We started Aveon Housing because finding a home in Lagos was broken — endless calls, mismatched expectations, mystery prices. Today we manage hundreds of verified apartments across Lagos and Ogun, and put every detail upfront so you can make confident decisions without an agent in the middle.
